description: This PHP script manages the execution flow for the 'Studio' module's wizards in SuiteCRM, including loading specific wizard classes based on user input, validating wizard names, and invoking methods for display or processing.

classes.name: StudioWizard
classes.description: Base class for Studio module wizards that provides methods like display, process, and back to handle user interactions.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Handles the 'back' action in the wizard flow, typically navigating to the previous step.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes user options or commands within the wizard flow.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the current wizard interface to the user.
